title: Witness Statement of Darren Kuczma (Evening Cashier)

sections.title: ## Witness Information
sections.content:
I, Darren Kuczma, am an evening cashier. This statement is true to the best of my knowledge and memory.

**Statement Date/Time:** 2026-01-02T10:35:00-05:00

I provided this account in plain terms and in order. I am describing what I personally saw and did during my shift.

sections.title: ## Account of Events
sections.content:
On the night of the incident, I was working my regular closing shift at the front register area. I stayed mainly at the counter and the walkway between the registers and the exit doors. I helped several customers, handled routine cash and card transactions, and did normal end-of-night tasks.

As my shift went on, I noticed the store was quieter than earlier. I continued to watch the front area, the doors, and the line like I normally do. I did not go into back rooms or restricted areas.

At one point I became aware of activity that made me pay closer attention to the front of the store. I looked toward the doors and the front lanes and tried to keep things calm and normal for customers.

I am aware that the front-area video system would have captured parts of the time I was at the register and near the exit. I did not access or change any recording. I understand the video is preserved as **EV003**.

I also handled register activity during my shift and completed the normal closing steps. I did not remove money outside normal procedures. I understand that register-related documentation and/or outputs may be included with **EV001** and **EV002**.

I did not chase anyone or leave my assigned area. I stayed focused on safety and completing my cashier duties.

sections.title: ## Additional Information
sections.content:
I cannot identify any person as responsible. I am not making any guesses about who did what.

If needed, I can point out the approximate area where I was standing at different times: usually behind the main register counter, sometimes at the bagging area, and occasionally near the front doors when checking the entry/exit.

I did not take any photos or recordings on my own. I did not speak to media or post about the incident. I am willing to answer follow-up questions and clarify anything I wrote here.
